votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of May 21, 2024
votes.description: The Board approved the minutes from the May 21, 2024 RDA meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 13 of 2024 authorizing the ground lease rate and terms for USA Climbing's Headquarters and National Training Facility at approximately 310 South 500 West
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution authorizing a ground lease for USA Climbing's Headquarters and National Training Facility, including adaptive reuse of the historic Salt Lake Mattress Company building and related development at approximately 310 South 500 West.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property and attorney-client matters
votes.description: The Board voted to enter a closed session to discuss real property transactions and attorney-client privileged matters.

votes.motion: Exit Closed Session and adjourn as the RDA
votes.description: The Board voted to conclude the closed session and adjourn the RDA meeting.
